title: We told n8n about a result. The next day someone had gone to the code
excerpt: What happens when you tell a vendor, in public and with fourteen days' notice, what you are going to publish about its product.
seo_title: We told n8n, and someone went to the code
seo_description: We told n8n in public what we would publish. The next day someone checked the code and drafted the missing documentation.
alt: Timeline: public notice to n8n on 26 November, someone checks the code on the 27th, result on 10 December.
